root_cause.message: nginx worker connections exhausted: worker connections are not enough

expected.business_impact: /portal/home production business path is affected by nginx_connection_exhaustion

primary_evidence.trace: Runtime trace follows nginx-ingress -> api-gateway -> portal-service and localizes the main fault at nginx-ingress.
primary_evidence.log: Root service logs contain NginxWorkerConnectionExhausted and nginx_connection_exhaustion keywords.
primary_evidence.metric: Metric nginx.connections.active breaches threshold on nginx-ingress.

non_root_noise: portal-service has no application exception and receives little traffic after ingress saturation
background audit-service warning is outside the affected call path
noise-service metric is normal and outside the affected call path
